main_measure.name: mean 7-bar excess return of forecast>0 cases over the coin's mean 7-bar return

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled (day-clustered)

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: t <= -2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of 7-bar excess return on forecast

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are grid bars (positions 0,7,14,... of each window, with a full 7-bar forward return inside it) with forecast > 0; the coin's mean 7-bar return is taken on the same grid over all its windows; the t sums each day's case deviations into one (day-clustered standard error); the plan's 'fewer than 30 days' rule is applied as the minimum count, giving 'not observable'.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +1.697 (not below 1), 78 cases (30 needed)
